mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_payroll ( payroll_code, company_code, user_id, payroll_period, payroll_type, bonus_method, bonus_rate, bonus_amount, payroll_name, payroll_start_date, payroll_end_date, payroll_date ) VALUES ( FN_MAKE_PAYROLL_CODE(), 'ROOT', #{userId}, #{payrollPeriod}, '상여', #{bonusMethod}, #{bonusRate}, #{bonusAmount}, #{payrollName}, #{payrollStartDate}, #{payrollEndDate}, #{payrollDate} )
mapper.select:
SELECT payroll_period, payroll_type, payroll_name, payroll_date, create_date, COUNT(*) AS peopleNumber FROM tb_payroll WHERE 1=1
AND payroll_name like '%' || #{payroll_name} || '%'
AND payroll_date >= TO_DATE(#{paymentStartDate} , 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND payroll_date <= TO_DATE(#{paymentEndDate} , 'YYYY-MM-DD')
GROUP BY payroll_period, payroll_type, payroll_name, payroll_date, create_date

SELECT user_id, user_name, dept, hire_date, job_title FROM tb_user_master WHERE 1=1 AND leave_date IS NULL
AND user_name like '%' || #{userName} || '%'
AND dept like '%' || #{dept} || '%'
AND hire_date >= TO_DATE(#{payrollEmpStartDate} , 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND hire_date <= TO_DATE(#{payrollEmpEndDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
